about.title: Passionate about interfaces that feel alive
about.body: Front-end developer at FundsDLT in Luxembourg since June 2020. Over 6 years, I've built a solid command of React, TypeScript, and the modern web ecosystem. On the side, I'm building ambitious personal projects — real-time systems, interactive pixel art, mobile apps — to explore what front-end can truly do. Actively looking for remote opportunities in Europe where this kind of work is valued.

photographer.title: Photographer Portfolio
photographer.description: Showcase site built with Svelte for a professional photographer. Organic warm design, serif typography, immersive gallery, optimised performance.

karate.title: Karaté Club Manager
karate.description: Mobile app for managing a karaté club — member tracking, attendance, belt progression, and an event calendar.

openspace.title: Virtual Open Space
openspace.description: Real-time pixel-art virtual office where employees navigate with custom avatars. Think Stardew Valley meets remote work.

contact.title: Let's work together
